modern: Remember that all is opinion. For what was said by the Cynic Monimus is clear; and clear too is the use of what was said, if a man takes what can be got out of it as far as it is true.
original: Remember that all is opinion. For what was said by the Cynic Monimus is manifest: and manifest too is the use of what was said, if a man receives what may be got out of it as far as it is true.
notification: Remember that all is opinion. For what was said by the Cynic Monimus is clear…
notification_original: Remember that all is opinion. For what was said by the Cynic Monimus is manifest…
